findings.title: Multiple valid relations touching one named note disappear from the shipped Rust SVG
findings.java_mechanism: Java opalizes a note only when exactly one visible relation touches it. `CucaDiagramFileMakerSmetana.isOpalisable` returns false once more than one link reaches the note, so the note stays a normal entity and the separate link groups remain visible.
findings.rust_mechanism: Rust mirrors the single-link opale test in `component_opalized_floating_note`, but when that function returns false the ordinary connection renderer still resolves endpoints only through components, interfaces, and packages. Named-note endpoints never resolve there, so every extra valid note relation falls through `continue` and no `<g class="link">` is emitted.
findings.impact: This disproves the account on fresh valid inputs spanning ASCII and Unicode code tokens, inline and multiline notes, both endpoint sides, nested ownership, and left-to-right direction. The parser fix is not enough for the shipped no-oracle path.

findings.title: The shared bare-code parser rewrite itself generalizes on the single-link matrix
findings.notes: These controls preserve the named-note or ordinary-endpoint model exactly enough to match entity ids and link inventories, and checker_01 shows the capture map still preserves multiplicity and label.

findings.title: Unicode qualified-name folding still differs in shipped SVG metadata
findings.notes: Java folds non-ASCII codepoints to dots in `data-qualified-name`; Rust emits raw Unicode. The account explicitly declares this as separate residue, so it is recorded but not used to reject.

findings.title: Invalid boundary tokens are rejected by Java but silently ignored by Rust
findings.notes: These probes do not count as held-outs, but they show the Rust parser currently treats invalid note-code lines as no-ops rather than matching Java's error behavior.

anti_overfit_audit.notes: Fresh labels such as Quoted Anchor, Anchor Display, retour, and late-note do not appear in production src. Existing Ledger/Métrique strings appear only in parser tests and prior review/account documents, not in shipping conditionals.
